item.description: Entered permissions/new/permissions.json in the Weekly Permissions sync of 25 September 2026, commit fa788f1. Microsoft publishes it as “Read identity lifecycle policies for agent identities” on Application and DelegatedWork, admin consent required, privilege level 3. Not yet on the public permissions reference, which stands at commit 47f6520 of 4 August 2026.

Not yet on the public permissions reference, which stands at commit 47f6520 of 4 August 2026.
